text: Who had a key to the stable door?
why: The door was locked, then found open, and Holmes asks whether a duplicate key was found, so the question follows naturally.

text: Why take the horse out of the stable?
why: Holmes asks this almost word for word.

text: Why take the horse out of the stable? — to take him for early exercise

text: Why take the horse out of the stable? — to steal him
why: The police theory is that Simpson took the horse out to kidnap him.
